main_text.p: Gregorius Episcopus Nazianzenus, multo sale respersas, tandem autem concludit: [Orat.2. in Iulianum{c}eos à quibus tyrannide oppressi sumus, mansuetudine vincamus, hac ratione, eis à quibus injurias accepimus, sublimiores nos praestamus.] Cyrillus autem Episcopus Alexandrinus in responsione ad libros Juliani, (quos teste {f}Hieronymo in expeditione Parthica contra Christum evomuit) in Epistola nuncupatoria ad Theodosium, non tam contra Regem se dicere profitetur, quàm pro gloria Christi, qui cum summo universorum Patre suo principatum gerit, de quo & solo dici debet ; per me Reges regnant. Postremò Milites Christiani, quod ad Idolis thurificandum adegit, non arma arripiunt, aut adversus eum coniurationem ineunt; sed [cùm venissent ad Principem (inquit §Eutropius) proiecerunt aurum, quod acceperant, & forti voce poscebant, ut reciperet quod dedisset, & occideret illos.] Tantùm abfuit illa ætas à Principe, vel omnium scelestissimo occidendo, ut ipsi occidi poposcerint. Necdis-similiterde hoc ipso Imperatore, & eisdem militibus In psal. 124, in illa verba; non derelinquet, &c.{h} D. Augustinus. ]Do-

page.notes: The first word of the page reads as a sentence fragment ("multo sale respersas"), so the opening paragraph is marked as continuing from the previous page. The marginal notes "f Epist.84." and "c Orat.2. in Iulianum" stand in the right margin; the note for f is at the mark before "Hieronymo" and is printed in the margin beside the lower lines, so it is placed there by its mark. The text is cut off at the lower edge of this part and continues on the second part of the scan. The side note marked g ("Rerum Rom. li. 11.") stands beside the line of "acceperant" in the right margin; its matching mark is the § before "Eutropius" in the text, which is unclear, so it is printed here as §. The note marked h is placed at the reference mark in the text. The first line is a fragment of a sentence continuing from the previous page. The word "similitèr" is printed with a grave accent on the e, and is transcribed as shown.
